title: Moving a kayak tour booking
ask: Aroha Williams has asked to move her Saturday kayak tour with Tidewater (booking TW-881) to Sunday. Her note is in inbox/customer.txt. Reply with her options and send it.
background: Sunday has room on the 8am and the 1pm departures.
She is bringing two friends who have not paddled before.
The forecast for Sunday is light wind, which suits beginners.

constraints.text: tell her the change fee in dollars, and it must not be more than $15
keep the whole reply under 100 words
give her the two departure times as a bulleted list of exactly two items
start with "Kia ora Aroha," on the first line
tell her the meeting point is Jetty 4

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: aroha.w@customer.example
Subject: Change booking TW-881

Kia ora, can we move our Saturday tour to Sunday? There are three of us.

Aroha
